dish: hokki (surf clam) seafood curry, hokki chirashi and Tomakomai miso-curry ramen
n: Michi-no-eki Utonai-ko (道の駅 ウトナイ湖)
address: Beside Lake Utonai, Tomakomai, Hokkaido, Japan
w: Beside Lake Utonai — a farm-and-fish shop and restaurant serving Tomakomai's hokki curry and the city's half-century-old miso-curry ramen.

dish: Biei-wheat-bun burgers (BETWEEN THE BREAD) and Blue Pond bakes
n: Michi-no-eki Biei Shirogane Birke (道の駅 びえい「白金ビルケ」)

w: A birch-wood station at the Blue Pond gateway — burgers on Biei-wheat buns with premium patties, a bakery and Blue-Pond-themed treats.
